prompt: What was David Fincher's most recently released feature film when Britney Spears' first feature film was released in the U.S.?
answer: David Fincher’s most recently released feature film was **_Fight Club_ (1999)** when Britney Spears made her feature-film debut in **_Longshot_ (2001)**, released in the U.S. as a cameo role.
